6.2.2.2.2 Flash driver
Detection Reported by the Flash controller (see Flash controller above). Reaction
 [SWS_Fls_00104] The job is aborted.
 [FLS052] The module state is set to MEMIF_IDLE, ready to accept RTE Application Layer System Services COM Drivers Memory Hardware Abstraction Mem Abstraction Interface Ext. EEPROM Driver µC Memory Drivers Int. EEPROM Driver SPI Handler Driver SPI EEPROM EEPROM Abstraction Memory Services NVRAM Manager External EEPROM Flash EEPROM Emulation Ext. Flash Driver Int. Flash Driver Flash RAM Test FIM DEM DET Notification Polling Recovery Detection Recovery Initiator 1 2 4 3 2 5 5 Description of the AUTOSAR standard errors new jobs. Report
 [SWS_Fls_00004] [SWS_Fls_00104] The error is reported to the DEM with the error code FLS_E_ERASE_FAILED. Depending on the Flash Driver configuration:
 [SWS_Fls_00104] [SWS_Fls_00035] The error shall be polled by the Flash EEPROM Emulation with the function Fls_GetJobResult (job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [SWS_Fls_00263] [FLS168] The error shall be reported to the Flash EEPROM Emulation by the callback function Fee_JobErrorNotification. Recovery See NVRAM Manager.
